jo (devex): Quick note: onboarding generator sample hangs in CI when the container gets SIGTERM. minimal repro attached in sandbox.

harry (go-sdk): thanks, can you paste the snippet?

jo (devex):```go
ctx := context.Background()
it := client.Generator(ctx, req)
defer it.Close()
for it.Next() { fmt.Print(it.Token()) }
```

nora (platform): that pattern is common but unsafe: Background() + long stream -> tests never exit cleanly.

harry (go-sdk): agreed. two fixes: (1) provide NewGeneratorWithCancel(ctx, req) that returns (it, cancel) so sample can do one-liner; (2) make iterator unstick on reconnect/auth-refresh and return Err() instead of blocking.

jo (devex): love the helper. also can we show signal.NotifyContext in the quickstart so example is production-friendly?

harry (go-sdk): yep. implementation plan: hook Close() to cancel internal ctx, add done chan so Next() selects on done, and ensure reconnect path sets iterator error. will add unit tests for mid-stream auth refresh + SIGTERM.

nora (platform): recommend documenting the Err kind: ErrAuthReconnect so infra teams can detect transient vs fatal.

harry (go-sdk): small typo in previous msg: harry. will add changelog entry and link PR once CI passes.
